## Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you want to request.

## Motivation

Why would this feature be useful? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you would like this feature to work. Include:

- API design (if applicable)
- Expected behavior
- Use cases

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Example Usage

If applicable, provide an example of how the feature would be used:

```cpp
// Example code here
```

## Impact

- **Breaking Changes**: Will this break existing code?
- **Performance Impact**: Will this affect performance?
- **Scope**: Is this a small feature or a major change?

## Additional Context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues for similar requests
- [ ] I have provided a clear description of the feature
- [ ] I have explained the motivation and use cases
- [ ] I have considered alternatives
